handshake.note: the site advertises (its switch is on): the next batch goes as v2
an advert inside the re-probe hold is ignored
the switch went off: the same batch on v1 now, adverts ignored for the hold
the site rolled back to a build without the v2 receiver: the same
no answer / timeout / connection error: unclear - the same v2 batch again later, never a v1 copy
a 413 that isn't the v2 route's own too_large (an older site's body parser after a rollback, nginx's page): a definite refusal - the same batch on v1 now, adverts ignored for the hold
the v2 route's own too_large at one event (it can't shrink): the same
the v2 route's own too_large with events to spare: fewer events per v2 batch (they grow back after clean posts)
